recipe.visualDefinition: A central cyan-tinted, low-contrast photograph of a group of figures walking on a beach, framed by a thick, textured wood-grain border and a high-contrast vertical red sidebar containing vertical text.
coreVisualRelationships: Cyan-blue central image versus warm wood-grain frame
Vibrant red vertical sidebar versus muted monochromatic photography
Sharp, blocky typography versus soft, atmospheric landscape
Vertical text orientation on the left versus horizontal text on the right
coreInvariants: Solid red vertical 'obi' strip on the left edge
Black rectangular text blocks overlapping the image top-left

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A group of six figures arranged in a staggered, receding line across the center of a cyan-tinted square frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The solid red vertical strip on the left acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the red strip to the dark text blocks at the top left, then follow the line of figures into the depth of the beach scene.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the sky and sand areas of the central photo, balanced by the dense information in the red strip.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red strip contrasts with the low-saturation, mid-value cyan photo and the high-value, low-saturation wood border.

letterConstructionRules: Tall, narrow proportions for display text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are placed inside solid black rectangular boxes with rough, torn edges
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of ultra-condensed display type against standard-width vertical body text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, bold display style
Matches the clean, functional look of the vertical text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square cyan-tinted monochromatic photo of a group of people walking on a misty beach, framed by a thick light-colored wood-grain border. Add a solid vibrant red vertical strip on the far left edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place two black rectangular boxes with slightly torn edges in the top left of the cyan photo. Inside the top box, add ultra-condensed cyan sans-serif text. In the bottom box, add wider cyan sans-serif text. Add vertical black text down the center of the red strip.

verificationChecks: Is the central photo strictly monochromatic cyan?
Is the red strip on the left solid and vibrant?
Are the text boxes at the top left black with rough edges?
Is the outer frame a visible wood-grain texture?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures on the beach
Roughness of the black text box edges
mustRedesign: Japanese characters (replace with English vertical text)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red strip is perfectly vertical and flush to the left.
Check that the wood grain looks natural and not like a flat color.
Verify the cyan text inside the black boxes is legible.
Confirm the figures in the photo are slightly blurred/atmospheric.
recipe.reuseFormula: Cyan-tinted beach photography + wood-grain frame + red vertical sidebar + condensed sans-serif text in torn black boxes.
